description: Work profile per DOM cycle: HAL calls and DB commands per port. Machine-independent, so it is immune to host noise and KVM steal.
metric: HAL calls/port/cycle; Redis commands/sweep; page histogram
notes: This is the VALIDITY GATE, not a performance result, and it must pass before any timing is trusted. It has already earned that status twice: it caught an 11-vs-3 divergence in SFP handle acquisition (Rust rebuilds a handle per call site, Python reuses sfp_obj_dict), and the Redis counters exposed a 3.08x WRITE amplification - RealDbTable::set (db.rs:139-149) issues one HSET per field where swsscommon Table.set issues a single multi-field HSET, 4352 vs 1411 commands per sweep. Any gap here is a fidelity defect, not a performance datum.
